_comment: Where the PWA's sources come from. This was one repo until the 2026-09-10 multi-repo split; now the Electron front-end, the Flutter front-end and the shared schema each live in their own repository, and fetch-app.mjs reassembles them into .app-src/ at the exact tree shape the build tools and all 13 shim/*.js files already expect. That reassembly is the seam: as long as .app-src looks like the old monorepo, nothing downstream had to change.
